description: Find a person's public GitHub, Bluesky, personal site, Substack, and X profiles from their full name and the domain of the company they work at. Returns one row per person with each profile URL, public follower counts, and a status (found, ambiguous, not_found, skipped, skipped_rate_limit, blocked) and a match confidence per platform. A profile counts as found only at 0.8 confidence or more, which needs a link to the company, the company's own team page, or a link to another profile of the same person; a name match alone is never enough. No emails, no phone numbers, LinkedIn is never opened, Substack is never read. X is used only when X_BEARER_TOKEN is set in this server's environment. A run that does not succeed is returned as an error with its run ID. Read-only; requires an APIFY_TOKEN and is billed per person with at least one profile found.

company_domain.description: The domain of the company the person works at, for example hashicorp.com.

full_name.description: The person's first and last name, for example Mitchell Hashimoto. Give this with company_domain, or use persons.

linkedin_url.description: Optional LinkedIn profile URL, used only for the words in it as a weak hint. LinkedIn is never opened.

location.description: Optional city or country; a profile in the same place gets a small boost.

max_charge_usd.description: Optional. The run stops before any row that would take its charges over this amount.

persons.description: Several persons, one per entry as Full Name | company.com. Up to 200 per run.

platforms.description: Which platforms to return. Omit for all five.

proxy_mode.description: auto retries a company or personal site page that refuses a direct request once through the Apify proxy; direct never uses a proxy. A reliability setting; it does not change the price. Default auto.

suppress_profile_urls.description: Profile URLs that must never be returned, for example people who asked to be removed.

name: map_person_social_footprint
title: Map a person's social footprint
